#### PR description:

This PR restricts the addition of the negative secondary vertices in PbPb MiniAOD only to Run 3 eras. Fixes the problems seen in https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/logreader/el8_amd64_gcc13/CMSSW_17_0_X_2026-10-20-2300/pyRelValMatrixLogs/run/140.5611_RunHI2018reMINIAOD/step2_RunHI2018reMINIAOD.log#/

@mandrenguyen

Tested with workflow 140.5611

title: Restrict PbPb negative secondary vertices only to Run 3 eras
